title: Scenes Composer
description: Lays a story out as scenes in time, grouped in beats, with layers of information across them.

schema.title: Composer
schema.description: A story laid out in time: beats that hold scenes, and the layers that run across them.

beats.title: Beats
beats.description: The beats of the story, in story order.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: The layers of the composer, in the order of their rows.

id.title: ID
id.description: What identifies an item in its composer. It never changes and no other item takes it later, so a link keeps pointing at the same item.

color.title: Color
color.description: The color the writer gave an item, as a six-digit hex value such as #3b82f6. An item without one has no color.

beat.title: Beat
beat.description: One step of the story: an ordered set of scenes.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the beat does in the story.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: The scenes of the beat, in story order.

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: The story's unit of time, and one column of the timeline.

description.title: Description
description.description: What happens in the scene, in the writer's own words.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the scene's column on a wide screen, in quarters of the base text size. A scene without one takes the default width.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: What the layers hold for the scene, with one cell per layer at most. A layer without a cell holds nothing for the scene.

cell.title: Cell
cell.description: What one layer holds for one scene. A cell names its layer and has the kind of that layer.

loglineCell.title: Logline
loglineCell.description: The scene told in one line.

text.title: Text
text.description: The line, as plain text without a line break.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: The blocks of the script, in reading order.

block.title: Block
block.description: One unit of script text: a narration or a line of dialogue.

narration.title: Narration
narration.description: Prose the narrator tells: action, description, a character's thoughts.

text.title: Text
text.description: The prose, as plain text. A blank line separates two paragraphs.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: Who speaks, by the name the story gives them.

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: How the line is said, such as "whispering" or "with a bitter laugh".

text.title: Text
text.description: The words spoken, without quotation marks.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: One row of the timeline, which follows one kind of information across the scenes.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the layer holds for each scene: notes, a logline, a script, or links to other items of the project.

label.title: Type
label.description: What the writer calls what the layer follows, such as a character or a place. A layer without one shows its kind.

height.title: Height
height.description: The least height of the layer's row on a wide screen, in quarters of the base text size. A layer without one is as tall as what it holds.

accepts.title: Accepted exports
accepts.description: On a link layer, the exports whose items its links point at, by name. The project keeps the links themselves, outside the composer.

blank.name: Blank
blank.description: One empty beat with one empty scene, to build a story from scratch.

hollywoodBeats.name: Hollywood beats
hollywoodBeats.description: The three acts of a classic film, in nine beats.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: The protagonist's ordinary world, and what is missing from it.

incitingIncident.title: Inciting incident
incitingIncident.description: An event upsets that world and raises the question the story will answer.

firstPlotPoint.title: First plot point
firstPlotPoint.description: The protagonist commits to the story. There is no way back, and act one ends.

risingAction.title: Rising action
risingAction.description: Obstacles grow as the protagonist goes after the goal, and allies and enemies take sides.

midpoint.title: Midpoint
midpoint.description: A reversal or a revelation raises the stakes and changes what the protagonist is after.

secondPlotPoint.title: Second plot point
secondPlotPoint.description: The worst setback. All seems lost, and act two ends.

crisis.title: Crisis
crisis.description: The protagonist gathers what is left and makes the choice that leads to the final confrontation.

climax.title: Climax
climax.description: The final confrontation, where the story answers its question.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The new balance, with what the story changed and what it cost.

fifteenBeats.name: 15 beats
fifteenBeats.description: A beat sheet in fifteen steps, from the opening image to the final one.

openingImage.title: Opening image
openingImage.description: A first picture of the protagonist's world, before the story changes it.

themeStated.title: Theme stated
themeStated.description: Someone says what the story is about, and the protagonist does not hear it yet.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: The protagonist's life, the people in it, and what needs to change.

catalyst.title: Catalyst
catalyst.description: An event makes the old life impossible.

debate.title: Debate
debate.description: The protagonist hesitates before the risk of the journey.

breakIntoTwo.title: Break into two
breakIntoTwo.description: The protagonist chooses to act and enters a new world. Act two begins.

bStory.title: B story
bStory.description: A second story begins, often a relationship, and carries the theme.

funAndGames.title: Fun and games
funAndGames.description: The premise keeps its promise, with the scenes the audience came for.

midpoint.title: Midpoint
midpoint.description: A false victory or a false defeat raises the stakes.

badGuysCloseIn.title: Bad guys close in
badGuysCloseIn.description: Enemies regroup outside, and doubts grow inside.

allIsLost.title: All is lost
allIsLost.description: The lowest point. Something or someone is lost for good.

darkNightOfTheSoul.title: Dark night of the soul
darkNightOfTheSoul.description: The protagonist faces the loss, and finds the truth the theme held.

breakIntoThree.title: Break into three
breakIntoThree.description: The two stories meet and give the answer. Act three begins.

finale.title: Finale
finale.description: The protagonist applies what was learned, and settles the conflict.

finalImage.title: Final image
finalImage.description: A last picture that answers the first, and shows the change.

start.title: Choose a structure to start from
start.description: A structure sets the beats of your story. You can rename, add and delete everything afterwards.

failures.load: We could not load this composer.
failures.save: We could not save your last changes.
